question: Is there free time, or is the schedule full?
answer: Our weekend retreats are relatively structured; however, you are welcome to pick which activities you wish to participate in. Nothing is compulsory, your retreat, your choice!
Our wish is that you get whatever you need out of this experience; if it means choosing to sauna or relax in the bath instead of hiking, then that is perfect.
There is space to rest, journal, explore the coastline, or simply unwind.
